name: NGC 2683 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 2683, a spiral galaxy seen almost edge-on, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc2683-hubble
story: A spiral galaxy turned almost edge-on to us, its profile recalling a classic science-fiction spaceship. That shape earned it the nickname the UFO Galaxy.

claims.text: NGC 2683 is a spiral galaxy seen almost edge-on
NGC 2683 is nicknamed the UFO Galaxy
NGC 2683 was a target of Hubble program 13442 (The Geometry and Kinematics of the Local Volume, PI Tully), ACS/WFC
